author: Zintenka
body:
This map is TDM! The point of the map is to blow the sh** out of each other and have fun! You can mine for diamonds and enchant your armor!

[TDM] Ka-Boom!



Author:
Zintenka

Features:
  • 50vs50
  • You spawn with no weapons but they are found in chests in spawn. 
  • TNT
  • Players who try to spawn kill will be harmed 4 HP! This will lessen the amount of attempters who want to spawnkill. 
  • Players who are in their spawn will be fully healed!
  • You have night vision.
  • Enchanting
  • Each kill gives you 16 xp bottles!
  • Diamond ore is scattered through out your island!

YML

Download 

Imgur Album

Enjoy!
